annotations.title: Generate UUIDs (v4 random, v7 time-ordered) or parse/validate one

description: Generate UUIDs (v4 random, v7 time-ordered) or parse/validate one. With no "uuid" parameter: generates up to 100 UUIDs of version 4 or 7 using a CSPRNG. With "uuid": validates it and returns the canonical form, version, variant and embedded timestamp (v1, v6, v7). Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
